result.brief: 提出表征引导（RG），用低维瓶颈形成并显式利用内部表征来修正流匹配目标，提升像素扩散 Transformer 的生成质量与效率。
result.reason: Studies what makes visual representations useful for generation in pixel diffusion transformers, introducing Representation Guidance with a compact latent bottleneck guiding flow-matching targets—directly relevant to RAE/generative latent representation learning.
